answer:
Derive from lib.dom plus one small hand-written table; do not generate from external data.
- ui has react/react-dom as peer dependencies and @types/react only as a devDependency, so React's JSX types are not a safe source (and use camelCase props and synthetic events, not our closures).
- `HTMLElementTagNameMap` and `GlobalEventHandlersEventMap` (lib.dom) give tags and event payloads with no dependency. A mapped type over them types events for free (see the probe on fn-35.D3).
- Attributes are the exception: DOM property names differ from attribute names, and runtime sets attributes as strings (`jsx-runtime.ts` RENAME maps only className and htmlFor). So type a curated attribute table per tag group (global, form, link, media...) by hand, with `aria-*` and `data-*` as template-literal index signatures.
- `style` is not supported today (`String(v)` would print "[object Object]"); an object form is a runtime change, so it is a separate decision.
Source: packages/ui/src/jsx-runtime.ts lines 57-58, 101; packages/ui/package.json devDependencies.
